top_news.title: Overseas Buyers In Hot Pursuit of US Crude as Wars Escalate
top_news.summary: An uptick in Asian and European demand for US crude is among the first signs of mounting concerns over adequate oil supplies amid multiplying geopolitical flashpoints.

top_news.title: Goldman Offers Way to Trade AI Junk Bonds $250 Million at a Time
top_news.summary: Goldman Sachs Group Inc. and JPMorgan Chase & Co. launched products this week allowing investors to quickly cut — or ramp up — exposure to tech industry debt, as concerns mount over hyperscalers’ huge future bond sales for artificial intelligence investments.

top_news.title: Wellington Is Passing on Data-Center Debt Deals on Property Value Concerns
top_news.summary: Data-center debt risks are rising, there’s uncertainty over what the properties are worth and returns are falling, according to Wellington Management.

top_news.title: Tesla Short Sellers Rake In $4 Billion as Shares Nosedive
top_news.summary: The deep plunge in Tesla Inc.’s stock on Thursday is turning into a major payday for its short sellers.

top_news.title: S&P 500 Suffers Worst Day in a Month as Oil Soars Over $100
top_news.summary: US stocks tumbled, with the S&P 500 Index suffering its worst day in a month, as doubts about whether the debt-fueled artificial-intelligence investment boom will pay off dragged down big tech stocks.

top_news.title: Heat Worries US Wheat Farmers Just as Crop Prices Surge
top_news.summary: For farmers in North Dakota surveying their wheat as harvest closes in, scorching heat is threatening yields just as crop prices rise to a three-year high.

top_news.title: Magnificent 7 Lose $797 Billion as AI Skeptics Dump Tech Stocks
top_news.summary: Wall Street is growing increasingly concerned about the hundreds of billions of dollars Big Tech is spending on artificial intelligence just as the resurgence of the war in Iran clouds the global macroeconomic outlook.

top_news.title: Stocks Hit by AI and War Jitters as Oil Tops $100: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: A surge in oil spurred by the escalating Iran war sent stocks and bonds lower, with Wall Street also rattled by renewed concerns over whether massive artificial-intelligence investments will pay off.
